source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Store Schedule II–V substances on open shelving inside a locked clinic room because the locked room alone satisfies the cabinet requirement.","B":"Keep Schedule II–V substances in an unlocked medication cart during operating hours when licensed clinicians are working on the unit.","C":"Use one shared access key for all employees so medications remain available while access restrictions are handled through end-of-day inventory.","D":"Store Schedule II–V controlled substances in a securely locked, substantially constructed cabinet or other storage meeting applicable DEA security requirements."}}
source_row.rationale: DEA guidance citing 21 CFR 1301.75(b) requires controlled substances listed in Schedules II–V to be stored in a securely locked, substantially constructed cabinet, subject to applicable security requirements.
